0022600101.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, 1-0 at home) are 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West, while the Golden State Warriors (0-1, 0-1 on the road) sit 13th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, one game back. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 133-112 at home on February 25, 2026. Memphis is missing Cedric Coward (wrist sprain) and Isaiah Stewart (ankle sprain), both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, while Golden State has Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery) out, with Brandin Podziemski (back soreness) and Charles Bassey (knee) day-to-day game-time decisions.
